script_parts.opening: Namaskar, MS Super Bihar Tyre Works se baat ho rahi hai? Bhai ji, main IndiaMART se bol raha hoon — aapka account kaafi purana hai, almost 9 saal se aap hamare saath hain, lekin last 30 dinon mein aapka login zero raha hai aur sirf 4 clickstream events record hue hain — yeh dekh ke thoda concern hua, isliye directly call kiya.
script_parts.diagnostic: Bhai, pehle yeh samajhna chahta hoon — kya koi specific problem aayi hai platform ke saath, ya business mein kuch changes hue hain jo aapko platform use karne se rok rahe hain? Kyunki aapki reply rate bhi 5.6% par aa gayi hai aur PNS success sirf 12.5% hai, matlab buyers aap tak reach hi nahi kar pa rahe.
script_parts.value_demo: Dekho bhai, aapka CQS score abhi 72 hai — threshold 75 ka hai, matlab sirf thodi si improvement se aapka catalog buyers ke liye zyada visible ho sakta hai. Aur yeh jo PNS 12.5% wali problem hai, iska seedha matlab hai ki 100 mein se 87 buyers jab call karte hain toh connect nahi ho pata — yeh directly aapka business loss hai, chahe lead aaye ya na aaye.
script_parts.action: Bhai, abhi call par hi ek kaam karte hain — main aapko guide karta hoon ki apna phone number aur availability settings update karein IndiaMART app mein, taaki PNS issue turant fix ho jaye; sirf 2 minute lagenge aur aaj se hi buyers aap tak reach kar payenge.
script_parts.close: Bhai ji, koi badi commitment nahi maang raha — bas yeh ek setting aaj fix kar lo aur agli baar jab main 7 din baad call karun, toh dekhtey hain ki PNS rate improve hua ya nahi; theek lagta hai?

script_parts_en.opening: Hello, am I speaking with MS Super Bihar Tyre Works? Sir, this is IndiaMART calling — your account is almost 9 years old with us, but in the last 30 days your login count is zero and only 4 clickstream events were recorded, which is what prompted me to call you directly today.
script_parts_en.diagnostic: Before anything else, I want to understand — has there been a specific issue with the platform, or have there been changes in your business that have been keeping you away? I ask because your reply rate has dropped to 5.6% and your PNS success rate is only 12.5%, which means buyers are simply not able to reach you.
script_parts_en.value_demo: Your current CQS score is 72, just below the 75 threshold — a small improvement there can meaningfully increase your catalog's visibility to buyers. More critically, a 12.5% PNS success rate means 87 out of every 100 buyers who try to call you cannot connect — that is direct business loss regardless of how many leads come in.
script_parts_en.action: Let's fix one thing right now on this call — I'll walk you through updating your phone number and availability settings on the IndiaMART app so that the PNS issue is resolved immediately; it will take just 2 minutes and buyers will be able to reach you starting today.
script_parts_en.close: I'm not asking for any big commitment, sir — just get this one setting fixed today, and when I call back in 7 days we can check together whether the PNS rate has improved; does that work for you?

objection_handlers.competitor_platform: Samajh sakta hoon — doosre platforms bhi kaam karte hain. Lekin IndiaMART pe B2B buyers specifically aate hain jo bulk order dene ka intent rakhte hain. Ek baar compare karte hain — aapke last 3 mahine ke leads ka source kya raha?
objection_handlers.price_too_high: Bilkul valid point hai. Lekin aise socho — agar sirf 2 orders extra aaye subscription se, toh ROI positive ho jaata hai. Main aapke category ke average order value se calculate kar sakta hoon.
objection_handlers.no_time: Koi baat nahi — main ek quick summary WhatsApp pe bhej deta hoon. Aap apne time pe dekh lena, aur jo bhi question ho directly reply karna.

objection_handlers_en.competitor_platform: I understand — other platforms work too. But IndiaMART specifically attracts B2B buyers who intend to place bulk orders. Let's compare — what was the source of your leads over the last 3 months?
objection_handlers_en.price_too_high: Completely valid point. But think of it this way — if just 2 extra orders come through the subscription, the ROI turns positive. I can calculate that using your category's average order value.
objection_handlers_en.no_time: No problem — I'll send you a quick summary on WhatsApp. Check it at your convenience, and just reply directly with any questions.
